title: Packers LB Zaire Franklin: Luther Burden said he'd make us quit, but he quit Sunday

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers LB Zaire Franklin: Luther Burden said he'd make us quit, but he quit Sunday
sources.description: The Packers blew leads late in losses to the Bears in both the regular season and playoffs last season, which would have provided Green Bay with plenty of motivation for Sunday's game at Lambeau Field all by itself.
